clos.original_description: Understand what is data mining and what are key components of the data mining pipeline
clos.enriched_description: Understand what is data mining and what are key components of the data mining pipeline, including Introduction to Data mining Pipeline, Data understanding, Data understadining, Data Warehouse Architecture.

clos.original_description: Learn and apply one of the basic core of data mining: data visualization
clos.enriched_description: Learn and apply one of the basic core of data mining: data visualization, including Data visualization, Introduction of data visualization, Visualization of Numerical Data, Visualization of Non-Numerical Data, The Visualization of Dashboard.

clos.original_description: Understand and apply one subtield in data mining: patern discovery, practice with the data visualization of data mining
clos.enriched_description: Understand and apply pattern discovery as a data mining subfield, including frequent, closed, max, compressed, sequential, and vertical-format pattern mining, advanced pattern discovery issues such as data streams and privacy, and data visualization practice for data mining.

clos.original_description: Apply another subtield in data mining: cluster analysis
clos.enriched_description: Apply cluster analysis as a data mining subfield, including similarity and distance measures, partitioning-based clustering, agglomerative and divisive hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, multidimensional categorization, and clustering quality evaluation.
